customers.evidence: Our hard work, and team work, keeps energy flowing.

employees.evidence: Our employees are dedicated to building capability, pursuing excellence and doing the right thing.

environment.evidence: we are committed to safety, reliability and environmental stewardship while protecting shareholder value.

community.evidence: improving lives by providing access to the energy which is essential to a high standard of living and health throughout the world.

shareholders.evidence: We are committed to financial strength, disciplined capital allocation, dividend growth and share repurchases.

integrity.evidence: We do this while living out our values of safety, honor and commitment

safety.evidence: we back that up with core company values of safety, honor and commitment.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice under the headline Providing Energy. Improving Lives. Opens with vision and values, then shifts to factual business description and a long company history. Shareholder commitments are absolute ('We are committed to'), while employees appear late and briefly. Customers and innovation are largely absent.
